content.rendered:
Students in the Sherwood School District have access to several information systems. These are listed below.

For questions or help regarding your login credentials, please visit your school’s media center or check in with any of your teachers.

  • Canvas (Grades 6-12) Course content, student-teacher communication)
  • StudentVUE (Grades 6-12) Grades, Scheduling, Fees, Attendance information
  • Naviance (Grades 9-12) College Application / Transcript management
